'# ======================== Python visual Power BI =========================
# Tarjetas KPI (consumiendo medidas (vis) sin agregarlas)
# - Muestra Actual / LY para: CN, AP, OP, NETOAI y márgenes derivados
# - Deltas: ΔCN% y Δ márgenes (puntos)
# - Field Parameter (Dimensión Finanzas) + paginación (Tienda -> 4 páginas; resto -> 1)
# - Título: usa ''Título Descripción (vis)'' si llega; si no, ''Dimensión''
# - Sucursal: tamaño de título dinámico (SUCURSAL_TITLE_FONTSIZE)
# - ORDEN configurable: ORDER_MODE = ''auto'' | ''crono'' | ''cn''
# ========================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import math
import unicodedata
import re

# ---------- Nombres de columnas del dataset ----------
DIM_COL      = "Dimensión"           # ''KPI Export (Dim)''[Dimensión]
CN_COL       = "CN (vis)"
CN_LY_COL    = "CN LY (vis)"
AP_COL       = "AP (vis)"
AP_LY_COL    = "AP LY (vis)"
OP_COL       = "OP (vis)"
OP_LY_COL    = "OP LY (vis)"
NA_COL       = "NETOAI (vis)"
NA_LY_COL    = "NETOAI LY (vis)"
TITLE_DESC_COL = "Título Descripción (vis)"   # opcional para el título

# (Opcionales para detectar dimensión y página)
PARAM_DIM_MEASURE  = "Param DimFin (texto)"
PARAM_DIM_COLUMN   = "Dimensión Finanzas Campos"
PARAM_PAGE_MEASURE = "Param Página (número)"
PARAM_PAGE_COLUMN  = "Página Facet"

# ---------- Layout / paginación ----------
N_COLS, N_ROWS = 6, 4
FACETS_PER_PAGE = N_COLS * N_ROWS
CARD_PAD = 0.001
TITLE_FONTSIZE, ROW_LABEL_FONTSIZE = 20, 15
VALUE_FONTSIZE, BADGE_FONTSIZE = 24, 15
COLOR_BORDER = "#E6E6E6"; COLOR_TEXT = "#333333"; COLOR_SUB = "#6C6C6C"
COLOR_BADGE_POS = "#38b2ac"; COLOR_BADGE_NEG = "#e57373"; COLOR_BADGE_TEXT = "#000000"

# Tamaño específico para títulos cuando la dimensión es Sucursal
SUCURSAL_TITLE_FONTSIZE = 14  # <- ajusta aquí

# ---------- ORDEN ----------
# ''auto''  : Mes/Trimestre/Año -> cronológico; resto -> CN desc
# ''crono'' : fuerza cronológico
# ''cn''    : fuerza CN desc
ORDER_MODE = "cn"

# ---------- Utils ----------
def normalize_text(s):
    s = str(s).strip().lower()
    return ''''.join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize(''NFKD'', s) if not unicodedata.combining(c))

def read_single_value(df, col, default=None, coerce_num=False):
    if col in df.columns and df[col].notna().any():
        vals = pd.unique(df[col].dropna())
        v = vals[0] if len(vals) == 1 else pd.Series(vals).mode().iloc[0]
        if coerce_num:
            try:
                vn = float(v); 
                return vn if np.isfinite(vn) else default
            except:
                return default
        return v
    return default

def first_non_null(series):
    s = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce") if series.dtype.kind in "iufc" else series
    s = s.dropna()
    return s.iloc[0] if len(s) else np.nan

def to_number(x):
    try:
        return float(str(x).replace(".", "_").replace(",", ".").replace("_", ""))
    except:
        return np.nan

def fmt_int(n):
    if pd.isna(n): return "-"
    s = f"{n:,.0f}"
    return s.replace(",", "X").replace(".", ",").replace("X", ".")

def fmt_pct(v):
    return "-" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:.0%}"

def coerce_int_page(v, default=1):
    try:
        if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v)): return default
        return max(1, int(float(v)))
    except:
        return default

# ---------- Parse helpers para orden cronológico ----------
_MONTHS = {
    "ene":1,"enero":1, "feb":2,"febrero":2, "mar":3,"marzo":3, "abr":4,"abril":4,
    "may":5,"mayo":5, "jun":6,"junio":6, "jul":7,"julio":7, "ago":8,"agosto":8,
    "sep":9,"sept":9,"septiembre":9, "oct":10,"octubre":10, "nov":11,"noviembre":11,
    "dic":12,"diciembre":12
}

def _parse_year(s):
    m = re.search(r"(20\d{2}|19\d{2})", s)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None

def _parse_month_label(label):
    """
    Devuelve (year, month, fallback_text) para ordenar.
    Acepta: ''Ene'', ''Enero'', ''ene 2024'', ''2024-01'', ''01/2024'', ''2024 1'', etc.
    """
    s = normalize_text(label)
    y = _parse_year(s)
    # YYYY-MM o YYYY/MM
    m = re.search(r"(19|20)\d{2}[-/\. ](1[0-2]|0?[1-9])", s)
    if m:
        if y is None: y = int(m.group(0)[:4])
        mon = int(m.group(2))
        return (y or 0, mon, s)
    # MM-YYYY o MM/YYYY
    m = re.search(r"(1[0-2]|0?[1-9])[-/\. ](19|20)\d{2}", s)
    if m:
        mon = int(m.group(1)); 
        if y is None: y = int(m.group(0)[-4:])
        return (y or 0, mon, s)
    # Nombre de mes (+ opcional año)
    for k, idx in _MONTHS.items():
        if re.search(rf"\b{k}\b", s):
            return (y or 0, idx, s)
    # Solo número de mes (1..12)
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(1[0-2]|[1-9])", s)
    if m:
        return (y or 0, int(m.group(1)), s)
    # Fallback: orden por texto
    return (y or 0, 99, s)

def _parse_quarter_label(label):
    """
    Devuelve (year, quarter, fallback_text) para ordenar.
    Acepta: ''Q1 2024'', ''T1 2024'', ''2024Q1'', ''2024 T1'', ''Trim 1 2024'', etc.
    """
    s = normalize_text(label)
    y = _parse_year(s) or 0
    # Q/T seguido o antes
    m = re.search(r"(?:q|t|trim)[^\d]*([1-4])", s)
    if m:
        q = int(m.group(1)); 
        return (y, q, s)
    # Formato ''YYYY Q'' o ''YYYY T''
    m = re.search(r"(19|20)\d{2}[^\d]*(?:q|t)[^\d]*([1-4])", s)
    if m:
        y2 = int(m.group(0)[:4]); q = int(m.group(2))
        return (y2, q, s)
    # Fallback: por texto
    return (y, 9, s)

def apply_order(grp, dim_key):
    mode = normalize_text(ORDER_MODE)
    if mode == "cn":
        return grp.sort_values("__CN__", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    if mode == "crono" or (mode == "auto" and dim_key in ("mes","trimestre","anio","ano","año")):
        # Orden cronológico según dimensión
        if dim_key == "mes":
            keys = grp[DIM_COL].apply(_parse_month_label)
            sort_df = pd.DataFrame(keys.tolist(), columns=["_y","_m","_t"])
            out = pd.concat([grp.reset_index(drop=True), sort_df], axis=1)
            out = out.sort_values(["_y","_m","_t"], ascending=[True, True, True]).drop(columns=["_y","_m","_t"])
            return out.reset_index(drop=True)
        elif dim_key in ("trimestre","trim","quarter"):
            keys = grp[DIM_COL].apply(_parse_quarter_label)
            sort_df = pd.DataFrame(keys.tolist(), columns=["_y","_q","_t"])
            out = pd.concat([grp.reset_index(drop=True), sort_df], axis=1)
            out = out.sort_values(["_y","_q","_t"], ascending=[True, True, True]).drop(columns=["_y","_q","_t"])
            return out.reset_index(drop=True)
        elif dim_key in ("anio","ano","año","year"):
            # intentar parsear año numérico
            def _year_key(x):
                s = normalize_text(x)
                y = _parse_year(s)
                # si no hay año, intenta castear entero
                if y is None:
                    try: y = int(re.sub(r"\D","",s))
                    except: y = 0
                return y
            return grp.assign(_y=grp[DIM_COL].apply(_year_key)).sort_values("_y").drop(columns="_y").reset_index(drop=True)
        else:
            # si no aplica, cae a CN desc
            return grp.sort_values("__CN__", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    # ''auto'' para otras dimensiones -> CN desc
    return grp.sort_values("__CN__", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- Validaciones mínimas ----------
need_cols = [DIM_COL, CN_COL]
missing = [c for c in need_cols if c not in dataset.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Faltan columnas requeridas en el Python visual: {missing}")

df = dataset.copy()

# Filtrado opcional por orden de dimensión (si llega desde el modelo)
DIMORD_COL = "Dimensión Finanzas Orden"
dim_orden = read_single_value(df, "DimFin Orden (vis)", default=None, coerce_num=True)
if dim_orden is not None and DIMORD_COL in df.columns:
    df = df[df[DIMORD_COL].astype(float) == float(dim_orden)]

# ---------- Detección de "Dimensión Finanzas" ----------
DIMFIN_ORDEN_MEASURE = "DimFin Orden (vis)"
DIMFIN_LABEL_MEASURE = "DimFin Label (vis)"

dim_label = read_single_value(df, DIMFIN_LABEL_MEASURE, default=None)
if dim_label is None:
    dim_orden = read_single_value(df, DIMFIN_ORDEN_MEASURE, default=None, coerce_num=True)
    mapping = {0:"Canal", 1:"Tienda", 2:"Sucursal", 3:"Trimestre", 4:"Mes", 5:"Año"}
    dim_label = mapping.get(int(dim_orden) if dim_orden is not None else -1, None)
if dim_label is None:
    dim_label = read_single_value(df, PARAM_DIM_MEASURE, default=None)
if dim_label is None:
    dim_label = read_single_value(df, PARAM_DIM_COLUMN, default=None)
if not dim_label:
    dim_label = "Canal"

dim_key = normalize_text(dim_label)
is_tienda   = ("tienda" in dim_key) or ("codigo 2" in dim_key)
is_sucursal = ("sucursal" in dim_key)

# ---------- Página actual ----------
page_raw = read_single_value(df, PARAM_PAGE_MEASURE, default=None, coerce_num=False)
if page_raw is None:
    page_raw = read_single_value(df, PARAM_PAGE_COLUMN, default=1, coerce_num=False)
page = coerce_int_page(page_raw, default=1)

# ---------- Preparación por faceta (sin agregación: tomamos el primer valor no nulo de cada medida) ----------
req_measures = [CN_COL, CN_LY_COL, AP_COL, AP_LY_COL, OP_COL, OP_LY_COL, NA_COL, NA_LY_COL, TITLE_DESC_COL]
for c in req_measures:
    if c in df.columns and df[c].dtype == object and c != TITLE_DESC_COL:
        df[c] = df[c].apply(to_number)

rows = []
for key, g in df.groupby(DIM_COL, sort=False):
    cn    = first_non_null(g[CN_COL])    if CN_COL    in g.columns else np.nan
    cn_ly = first_non_null(g[CN_LY_COL]) if CN_LY_COL in g.columns else np.nan
    ap    = first_non_null(g[AP_COL])    if AP_COL    in g.columns else np.nan
    ap_ly = first_non_null(g[AP_LY_COL]) if AP_LY_COL in g.columns else np.nan
    op    = first_non_null(g[OP_COL])    if OP_COL    in g.columns else np.nan
    op_ly = first_non_null(g[OP_LY_COL]) if OP_LY_COL in g.columns else np.nan
    na    = first_non_null(g[NA_COL])    if NA_COL    in g.columns else np.nan
    na_ly = first_non_null(g[NA_LY_COL]) if NA_LY_COL in g.columns else np.nan

    mb    = (cn + ap)/cn if pd.notna(cn) and cn != 0 and pd.notna(ap)    else np.nan
    mb_ly = (cn_ly + ap_ly)/cn_ly if pd.notna(cn_ly) and cn_ly != 0 and pd.notna(ap_ly) else np.nan
    mo    = op/cn   if pd.notna(cn)   and cn   != 0 and pd.notna(op)    else np.nan
    mo_ly = op_ly/cn_ly if pd.notna(cn_ly) and cn_ly != 0 and pd.notna(op_ly) else np.nan
    mn    = na/cn   if pd.notna(cn)   and cn   != 0 and pd.notna(na)    else np.nan
    mn_ly = na_ly/cn_ly if pd.notna(cn_ly) and cn_ly != 0 and pd.notna(na_ly) else np.nan

    d_cn = (cn/cn_ly - 1) if pd.notna(cn_ly) and cn_ly not in (0, np.inf, -np.inf) else np.nan
    d_mb = (mb - mb_ly) if pd.notna(mb) and pd.notna(mb_ly) else np.nan
    d_mo = (mo - mo_ly) if pd.notna(mo) and pd.notna(mo_ly) else np.nan
    d_mn = (mn - mn_ly) if pd.notna(mn) and pd.notna(mn_ly) else np.nan

    # título con descripción (si llega)
    title_desc = None
    if TITLE_DESC_COL in g.columns:
        td = g[TITLE_DESC_COL].dropna()
        if len(td):
            title_desc = str(td.iloc[0])

    rows.append({
        DIM_COL: key,
        "TITLE_DESC": title_desc,
        "__CN__": cn, "__CN_LY__": cn_ly, "__D_CN__": d_cn,
        "__AP__": ap, "__AP_LY__": ap_ly,
        "__OP__": op, "__OP_LY__": op_ly,
        "__NA__": na, "__NA_LY__": na_ly,
        "__MB__": mb, "__MB_LY__": mb_ly, "__D_MB__": d_mb,
        "__MO__": mo, "__MO_LY__": mo_ly, "__D_MO__": d_mo,
        "__MN__": mn, "__MN_LY__": mn_ly, "__D_MN__": d_mn
    })

grp = pd.DataFrame(rows)
grp = grp.dropna(subset=["__CN__", "__MB__", "__MO__", "__MN__"], how="all")

# ---------- ORDEN (cronológico o por CN) ----------
grp = apply_order(grp, dim_key)

# ---------- Paginación ----------
total_facets = len(grp)
if total_facets == 0:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,3)); ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "Sin datos.", ha="center", va="center"); plt.show(); raise SystemExit

total_pages = max(1, math.ceil(total_facets / FACETS_PER_PAGE))
ENFORCE_TIENDA_RULE = True
allowed_max_pages = min(4, total_pages) if (ENFORCE_TIENDA_RULE and is_tienda) else (1 if ENFORCE_TIENDA_RULE else total_pages)
page = max(1, min(page, allowed_max_pages, total_pages))

start, end = (page-1)*FACETS_PER_PAGE, (page-1)*FACETS_PER_PAGE + FACETS_PER_PAGE
page_df = grp.iloc[start:end].reset_index(drop=True)

# ---------- Dibujo de tarjeta (Actual / Δ) ----------
fig_w, fig_h = max(6, N_COLS*6.0), max(4, N_ROWS*4.0)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(N_ROWS, N_COLS, figsize=(fig_w, fig_h))
if N_ROWS == 1 and N_COLS == 1: axes = np.array([[axes]])
elif N_ROWS == 1: axes = np.array([axes])
elif N_COLS == 1: axes = axes.reshape(-1,1)

x_label, x_act, x_badge = 0.03, 0.6,  0.80
row_y = [0.7, 0.5, 0.3, 0.1]  # CN, MB, MO, MN

def draw_badge(ax, x, y, text, positive=True):
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha="left", va="center",
            fontsize=BADGE_FONTSIZE, color=COLOR_BADGE_TEXT,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3",
                      fc=COLOR_BADGE_POS if positive else COLOR_BADGE_NEG,
                      ec="none"))

for i in range(FACETS_PER_PAGE):
    r, c = divmod(i, N_COLS)
    ax = axes[r, c]
    ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.axis("off")
    if i >= len(page_df): continue
    row = page_df.iloc[i]

    # marco tarjeta
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((CARD_PAD, CARD_PAD), 1-2*CARD_PAD, 1-2*CARD_PAD,
                               fill=False, ec=COLOR_BORDER, lw=1.2))

    # ----- TÍTULO -----
    if ("TITLE_DESC" in row) and pd.notna(row["TITLE_DESC"]) and str(row["TITLE_DESC"]).strip() != "":
        title_text = str(row["TITLE_DESC"])
    else:
        title_text = str(row[DIM_COL]).upper()
    title_size = SUCURSAL_TITLE_FONTSIZE if is_sucursal else TITLE_FONTSIZE

    ax.text(0.5, 0.90, title_text, ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=title_size, color=COLOR_TEXT, wrap=True)

    # ----- Filas -----
    labels = ["CN",  "Margen bruto", "Margen operativo", "Margen neto A.I."]
    act_vals = [row["__CN__"],  row["__MB__"], row["__MO__"], row["__MN__"]]
    delta_keys = [ "__D_CN__", "__D_MB__", "__D_MO__", "__D_MN__" ]

    for y, label, a, dk in zip(row_y, labels, act_vals, delta_keys):
        ax.text(x_label, y, label, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=ROW_LABEL_FONTSIZE, color=COLOR_SUB)

        if label == "CN":
            ax.text(x_act, y, fmt_int(a), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=VALUE_FONTSIZE, color="#333333")
        else:
            ax.text(x_act, y, fmt_pct(a), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=VALUE_FONTSIZE, color="#333333")

        if dk is not None and pd.notna(row[dk]):
            if label == "CN":
                txt = f"{row[dk]:+.0%}"; pos = row[dk] >= 0
            else:
                txt = f"{row[dk]*100:+.0f}p"; pos = row[dk] >= 0
            draw_badge(ax, x_badge, y, txt, positive=pos)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
